dataCategory: synthetic operator-authored samples only; no personal, repository, account or provider message data

credentialLifecycle.deviceTokenExpiresAt: session start plus 600 seconds; unchanged across restart
credentialLifecycle.cleanup: At work cutoff stop admission, interrupt and reap owned runtime, stop listener and native app, revoke session enrollment/device rows, delete only issued Fort Keychain items and temporary connection/enrollment files, verify no residue before absolute expiry
credentialLifecycle.failure: Consume session start, preserve state/ledger, stop; no renewal or automatic replacement outside remaining approved sessions

preservation.nativeCache: archive exact current cache before pairing; retain each new synthetic session history

riskDelta: More synthetic model turns and one supervised restart than the previous one-message trial. No higher privileges or new sensitive data. The agent host retains the Mac user access; the computer-tool profile does not provide agent-host confinement.
executionPins: Verify each source, app and runtime revision independently against this unchanged scope before launch. A routine code revision is not renewed credential authority.
